summary: A grown child, and then the whole family, tells the candidate in writing that he should run, yet he still declines.
realLife: Mitt Romney said in 2016 that his wife and children urged him to run again for president, and one son emailed that he had to get in. Even with that pressure, he decided against an independent bid.
gates: The player has grown children and a spouse who support the run.
A party or donors have been asking.
weights: Odds as the player sees them.

turns.what: The family does not want him to run, and the player is the one wanting to.
